page.overview:
Who is Beska?

Beska was a human female who worked for the Imperial Security Bureau. She was one of Supervisor Lonni Jung's agents, who reported to Lagret at the Senate Building. Senator Bail Organa had her and two other agents — Charval and Selko — perfom an extraction to safely escort Mon Mothma off Coruscant. Beska and the other agents did not know the team was under Organa's personal command. Unbeknownst to Organa, Charval and Selko, Beska was a plant with orders to prevent Mothma's escape. As one of Supervisor Jung's agents, Luthen Rael was made aware of the team's compromise and sent another agent to intercept.

After Charval overheard Beska communicating with Lagret, she pretended she was just contacting "work." Charval became suspicious about Beska and requested her to hand him the communication device. She feigned a handoff, then killed Charval.

After Mothma's speech about the Ghorman Massacre, Beska intercepted her escort by Cassian Andor and attempted to arrest her while drawing a blaster. She ordered Andor, Selko and everyone else to stand down, as she was taking Mothma into custody for an ISB authorized arrest. However, Andor killed her with a shot to the temple from his blaster after she was distracted by Erskin Semaj calling her a "rebel spy."

Beska was a human female with blue eyes and brown hair tied in a bun. She was loyal to the Galactic Empire, serving the Imperial Security Bureau. She also served as a spy who infiltrated Bail Organa's resistance movement.
